name: timeless-resurfacing-theme
description: Build pipeline for Timeless Resurfacing WordPress theme. Compiles Tailwind CSS locally to replace CDN.

scripts.build: postcss src/main.css -o assets/main.min.css --env production && node -e "const f='assets/main.min.css';const s=require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(!s.includes('@layer theme,base,components,utilities')){require('fs').writeFileSync(f,'@layer theme,base,components,utilities;'+s);console.log('Injected @layer order declaration');}"
